name: TV DIABLO Windows
note: v3358: HE OPENS THE PANEL NAMED YOUR REELS AND SEES NO REELS. MEASURED on his LIVE console at his real 1120x660, shelf freshly opened at scrollTop 0: sh-head top 123, sh-hi top 197 height 174, sh-timeline top 387 height 156, sh-search-wrap top 559, sh-grid top 670 and THE FIRST REEL CARD AT 708 - in a 660px viewport. I opened it and looked: a heading, five highlight tiles, a chart, and the fold. Not one of his twelve reels. After the reorder the first card sits at 346 and three cards are on screen; I looked again to confirm it rather than trusting the rectangles. ATTRIBUTED BY DELTA, not by argument: walking control_ui.html back commit by commit, through v3288 the order was cards then ACTIVITY then lanes then story then highlights - exactly the BAND that test_the_shelf_shows_reels_before_it_shows_charts pins - and v3289 changed it to highlights then ACTIVITY then cards. BOTH shelf laws have been red on BOTH venues ever since, for 68 versions. ⚠⚠ AND THE COMMENT ABOVE THE CHANGE PROMISED A GUARD THE CODE NEVER HAD: it says v3289 raised the records strip and the chart ONLY, and only with an open-on-a-reel guard. There is no such guard - the highlights builder returns empty only when there are NO runs, and the timeline div is non-empty whenever cards is - and it raised the HIGHLIGHTS too, which that sentence does not claim. A comment stating a rule the adjacent code does not implement is worse than no comment. ORDER ONLY: nothing removed, no id moved, every analytic block still renders in full, and v3121 ruling is kept because ACTIVITY still LEADS the analytic band, just from below the list where the band lives. ⚠⚠⚠ AND BOTH LAWS WERE DEAD IN BOTH DIRECTIONS - they could neither pass nor prove. FIVE inert red-proofs are repaired here and every one was disarmed by an edit to the thing it guards: three shelf proofs anchored on text this reorder moved, one anchored a comment MY v3355 reworded from malformed-slash-unreadable to malformed-OR-unreadable, and one anchored a line MY v3354 rewrote. Three of my last four versions each silently made an EARLIER law unprovable and only the heart census saw any of them. ⚠ ONE WAS NOT AN ANCHOR PROBLEM AT ALL: the badge-tooltip proof matched once and stayed GREEN, so the LAW was weak - it asserted the bare name b.title, which occurs 5 times in control_ui.html while the guarded statement occurs once, so deleting the real line left four others standing. It now asserts the full expression. ⚠ THE WINDOW HELPER WAS READING 1,700 OF 13,121 CHARACTERS: its end anchor was semicolon-newline, and the head builds its population label with an inline function whose INNER statement carries the first one - so every marker past it read as ABSENT and three cases reported that the grid and the river strip had been REMOVED from a page they were sitting in. It now ends at the first operand line at the chains own six-space indent, and it REFUSES rather than reporting an absence when it cannot see its own subject. My first two attempts at that bound were themselves wrong and the corrections are written into the helper. ⚠ AND I TRUNCATED TWO LAW FILES WHILE REPAIRING THEM, deleting the __main__ runner below RED_PROOF; heart2 then reported all five proofs BLIND, because a law that cannot RUN cannot go red and the prover cannot tell that from a toothless guard. Restored and re-proven. HEART: a console_doctor row now reads the assembly order and goes MISSING when any analytic block leads the reel cards, so this reaches a human instead of sitting in two red laws nobody read - proven red on the pre-v3358 order and green after, 2 ms. It is declared in NO_JOINT_YET, not COVERED_BY, and the entry names the joint that is missing: the real second source is RENDERED geometry, first card top against viewport height at his width, and the render target that watches this grid proves cards ARRIVE and never that one is above the fold. That is exactly how this survived 68 versions. 478 gates - this version adds no new law, it repairs two that existed and could neither pass nor prove.
